To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the optical properties of metal coated Si NP arrays are strongly influenced by the interplay of Mie like geometric resonance in the NPS, localized surface plasmon resonance in the metal disks and propagation of surface plamon polariton along the metal backreflector/ Si substrate interface.

the metal coated Si NP array exhibits a strong reflection dip, which is attributed to the interplay of geometric resonance in the NPS, localized surface plasmon resonance in the metal disk, and the surface plasmon propagating along the metal backreflector/air interface.

metal coating can significantly enhance light confinement and absorption in Si NP arrays and this effect is mainly attributed to the interplay of plasmonic effects with the geometrical resonance in NPs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the interplay of plasmonic and geometrical resonances in the hybrid metal Si nanostructures.
the optical characteristics and the light confinement in the metal Si NP hybrid nanostructures.
the interplay of plasmonic effects with geometric resonance in metal coated Si NPs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the interplay between the geometrical resonance and plasmonic effects in metal coated Si NP arrays could result in the strong confinement and absorption of light.
the metal coating on Si NP arrays can significantly improve the optical characteristics of the Si NP arrays.
the metal coating of the Si NP array can enhance the light confinement in the NPs and the local absorption in the Si NPs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

metal coating could be an efficient approach to improve the light absorption of Si NPs and the absorption enhancement was mainly attributed to the interplay of plasmonic effects in the metal disks and the geometric resonance in the Si NPs.
metal coating on the Si NPs could significantly enhance light trapping in the hybrid nanostructures.
the metal coated Si NPs could be used as efficient absorbers for solar energy harvesting applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
metal coating can be used to enhance light confinement and absorption in Si NPs.
the metal coating can be used to enhance light trapping and absorption in thin film Si solar cells.
the hybrid nanostructures can be used as efficient light absorbers for photovoltaic and photoelectrochemical applications.
